verdict.rationale: Eqvista is an equity management SaaS platform, so a built-in AI assistant is a fair axis to ask about. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions an AI assistant, copilot, or agent that can take delegated tasks. The only AI-adjacent item is an llms.txt file, which describes the product for external LLMs and is not an in-product assistant.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
